text: The Blakers-Massey theorem in HoTT (proved by Anel-Biedermann-Finster-Joyal 2017) is a:
choices: result about the fundamental group of the circle
connectivity bound for the comparison map between homotopy pushouts and pullbacks
proof that all higher homotopy groups of spheres are finitely generated
explanation: Blakers-Massey: if f: A→C and g: B→C are m- and n-connected, then the comparison map A×_C B → A×B is (m+n)-connected. In HoTT, this was first proved using lex modalities.
